string-array.name: rd_whats_new_items
string-array.item: The player on a phone held sideways shows the Landscape layout of Customize Player again, on the row under the seek bar.
Turning the phone with the controls up keeps the buttons of the top bar.
Subtitles drawn into the picture stay above the controls.
Bookmarks opened from the options before the controls were ever shown no longer close the app.
